mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_log (product_id, product_code, product_name, stock_type, quantity, before_stock, after_stock, order_id, create_time) VALUES (#{productId}, #{productCode}, #{productName}, #{stockType}, #{quantity}, #{beforeStock}, #{afterStock}, #{orderId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_log WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 20
